title: Workflow checks out the pull-request head ref (gha)
description: A gha workflow checks out the contributor's head ref (ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}). When the workflow is also triggered by pull_request_target it runs with the base repository's secrets and a write token, so code from a fork executes with maintainer permissions; the checkout of the head is the step that introduces the untrusted code. This lexical rule flags that checkout; the reviewer removes it or switches to a two-step artifact hand-off.
remediation: Use pull_request for untrusted code, or keep pull_request_target and never check out the head; when the head must be built, check out the base ref instead.
limitation: Line-based on the workflow file: it flags a checkout step that names the pull-request head ref, not the job's trigger or the full job graph, so a head checkout in an unprivileged pull_request workflow is also reported.
